column1: # Real-data training matrix for KCL CREATE.
# One row = one Slurm array task = one (dataset, policy) training run. Submit
# with `bash hpc/submit_real.sh` on a CREATE login node; it filters these rows,
# checks each dataset is staged, snapshots what it submits, and groups the rows
# by wall time so a short cell does not queue behind a long reservation.
# Columns, whitespace-separated. `-` means "use the driver's default for this
# policy" (test/system/long_vla_real.sh). `extra` is the LAST column and may
# contain spaces: it is passed to lerobot-train verbatim, so any flag the driver
# does not name is still reachable from here.
#   dataset : directory name staged under $HF_LEROBOT_HOME/local/
#   policy  : act | diffusion
#   steps   : optimiser steps          (default: act 80000, diffusion 100000)
#   batch   : batch size               (default: act 8,     diffusion 32)
#   hours   : Slurm wall time, hours   (rows sharing a value share one array)
#   extra   : raw lerobot-train flags, or `-`
# Left out on purpose: short_fold (1 episode) and cube-dual-pnp (2 episodes) are
# smoke-sized, not training-sized -- use them with test/system/smoke_vla_real.sh.
# dataset            policy     steps   batch  hours  extra
cube-pnp             act        80000   8      24     -
cube-pnp             diffusion  100000  32     24     -
cube-dual-pnp-new    act        80000   8      36     -
cube-dual-pnp-new    diffusion  100000  32     36     -
fold-short           act        80000   8      36     -
fold-short           diffusion  100000  32     36     -
